judged_text: The migration hardcodes `default: 1`, duplicating Post.cook_methods' positional mapping (:regular = 1) instead of deriving it, so the meaning of every stored cook_method value is coupled to member order in the Enum. The next editor who inserts a cook method before :raw_html (or reorders members) silently redefines the meaning of every existing row in the posts table with no error anywhere; nothing cross-checks the migration constant against the Enum.
